known_issues.title: Beamos scorch marks last a few ticks longer
known_issues.detail: Hot_Floor 231 under a Beamos beam fades a few ticks later at 60: its own heat and fade are stepped as at 30 (the beam sets it each step, cLib_chaseF up 5 a tick while hit, down 0.4 after); the beam's half-step positions sweep a scorch once more than 30's whole-tick jumps do and add heat (finer sampling of the beam's path, like the water jar's edge): left as inherent (session bottom)

known_issues.title: A thrown water jar can break on an edge 30 misses
known_issues.detail: Dragon Roost room 8: thrown from about 100 units further back, the jar breaks on the floor's edge at 60 but in the lava at 30; 60's finer sampling catches an edge 30's step jumps over Decided (session bottom): inherent to the finer sampling (the jar moves on 30's ticks; its arc grazes the edge between two of them, where a 60 step lands), left.

known_issues.title: Ganon's Tower trial: the magma rocks' bob differs
known_issues.detail: The walk-in now ends on 30's tick. The rocks follow the lava under them, whose bubbles come from the random stream: at 60 the stream reaches them in another state, so the lava (and its rock) sits up to 20 units off, the rock right relative to its lava (as Fire Mountain's rocks); matching it needs the bubbles' draws synced

known_issues.title: Link: an action can change a tick off after his path drifts
known_issues.detail: Fixed: the turn in place and waiting start on 30's ticks, and the turn while moving ends on 30's tick (it ended a tick early). Left: an action that starts at a threshold (a ledge reached, a turn's last 8000-unit step, a wall) can come a tick apart once his path is a few units or a degree off 30's, as in routes sidle and tour's corner

known_issues.title: Random-driven enemies drift from the 30 fps run
known_issues.detail: Random-driven enemies (Magtail waits, Peahat flights) drift from the 30 fps run, as expected

known_issues.title: Pots, sidling and ladders: two small leftovers
known_issues.detail: Checked tick by tick at 30 and 60. Fixed: a thrown pot sank too fast in water (now within 0.2 units), and sidling ran up to 2.3 units ahead (now on 30's ticks). Lifting, carrying and throwing a pot, and a ladder up and down, already matched (the ladder within 0.2 units). Left: a turn while carrying can end half a tick off after a tiny earlier drift, and sidling round a corner isn't tested yet

known_issues.title: Windfall at night
known_issues.detail: The lights converted (night via WWHD_DEBUG_TIME=905:345). The auction's bidders and the auction (361, 382) and the shutters (259) are converted; by night (Orichh room 0, layer 1) the bidders and the auction are 30's at every tick but for IDs given at their creation (session bottom). Not tested: the bidding (after talking to the auctioneer) and the shutters' open and close, which by the notes and decomp run in events (B67)

known_issues.title: Enemies falling into water
known_issues.detail: At 30 they hang at the surface about 2 ticks before sinking, at 60 they sink from the first contact: the in-water check runs a line from the last step's place, a whole tick back at 30 and half a tick at 60 (sampling, not a count; recorded in tick_rules.txt)

labels.242: spawned by code; its profile sits between Phantom Ganon's (241) and Puppet Ganon's (243)
labels.444: spawned by code; its profile sits between the Ballad's cyclone (TORNADO 443) and LOD (445)

queue_note: Round 11 (2026-10-07): the actors are converted (397 of 452, 50 need nothing; the rest wait on B67's events and an early save). All three sessions fix known bugs until 90% of the week: qa the event-only actors (B67) with a setup built for each, bottom the Darknut lunge (B66), top predeploy's WARN routes and the hands-on known issues. Known bugs only, no new hunting. The main session routes the owner's bugs and notes and deploys in batches. Next: the owner's extensive testing and repair.

queue.name: Round 11, the event-only actors (qa's, B67): a setup for each event, a probe run (WWHD_DEBUG_EVENTACT) and its rules: the shutters (259, on their switch), Windfall's night auction (361, 382), the salvage chest (SBOX 293), the gallery viewer (OBJ_FIGURE 404), Windfall's picture puzzle (Obj_Apzl 281), Obj_HSH 290, the Earth Temple's light, Ganon's Tower; then NPC_PF1 356 on Windfall's layer 0

Round 11 (bottom's): pots, sidling and ladders routed at 30 and 60 (pick up, carry, throw and break a pot; sidle both ways and round a corner; a ladder up and down, on and off), what differs fixed; B66 (the Darknut lunge) parked: its last gap is Link's animation blend

Round 11 (top's): predeploy's WARN routes (land2 45, plants 41, sail 52, tour2 51 units from 30's end): each's cause fixed, steered off its threshold or recorded; then what's left of Link's actions starting half a tick early

later: The owner's extensive testing and repair, once the actors are converted (the whole queue redistributed then)
